query: Let `P` be an affine space over a strictly ordered ring `R` with model module `V`, and let `f : StdSimplex R (StdSimplex R P)` be a "simplex of simplices" (a probability distribution over probability distributions over `P`). Then the convex combination of the inner combinations equals the convex combination of the joint distribution: `convexCombination (f.map convexCombination) = convexCombination f.join`.

    12  /-!
    13  # Affine spaces are convex spaces
    14  
    15  This file shows that every affine space is a convex space.
    16  
    17  ## Main results
    18  
    19  * `AddTorsor.toConvexSpace`: An affine space over a module is a convex space.
    20  * `AddTorsor.sConvexComb_eq_affineCombination`: The convex combination equals the affine
    21    combination.
    22  * `AddTorsor.convexCombPair_eq_lineMap`: Binary convex combinations are given by `lineMap`.
    23  -/
    24  
    25  public noncomputable section
    26  
    27  open scoped Affine
    28  
    29  variable {R V P I : Type*}
    30  variable [Ring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
    31  variable [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V] [AddTorsor V P]
    32  
    33  open Convexity
    34  
    35  namespace AddTorsor
    36  
    37  /-- The convex combination of points in an affine space, given a probability distribution. -/
    38  @[expose]
    39  def convexCombination (s : StdSimplex R P) : P :=
    40    s.weights.support.affineCombination R id s.weights
    41  
    42  theorem convexCombination_single (x : P) :
    43      convexCombination (StdSimplex.single x : StdSimplex R P) = x := by
    44    simp only [convexCombination, StdSimplex.single]
    45    rw [Finsupp.support_single _ one_ne_zero]
    46    exact ({x} : Finset P).affineCombination_of_eq_one_of_eq_zero _ _
    47      (Finset.mem_singleton_self x) Finsupp.single_eq_same fun j _ hne => Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hne
    48  
    49  theorem convexCombination_assoc (f : StdSimplex R (StdSimplex R P)) :
    50      convexCombination (f.map convexCombination) = convexCombination f.join := by
    51    -- Choose a base point
    52    obtain ⟨b⟩ : Nonempty P := inferInstance
    53    -- Express both sides using weightedVSubOfPoint with base point b
    54    have hL := Finset.affineCombination_eq_weightedVSubOfPoint_vadd_of_sum_eq_one
    55      (f.map convexCombination).weights.support (f.map convexCombination).weights id
    56      (f.map convexCombination).total b
    57    have hR := Finset.affineCombination_eq_weightedVSubOfPoint_vadd_of_sum_eq_one
    58      f.join.weights.support f.join.weights id f.join.total b
    59    simp only [convexCombination, hL, hR]
    60    congr 1
    61    -- Now show the weighted vector sums are equal
    62    simp only [Finset.weightedVSubOfPoint_apply, StdSimplex.map, StdSimplex.join, id]
    63    -- Rewrite LHS using sum_mapDomain_index
    64    change (Finsupp.mapDomain convexCombination f.weights).sum (fun x w => w • (x -ᵥ b)) = _
    65    rw [Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index (fun _ => by simp) (fun _ _ _ => by simp [add_smul])]
    66    simp only [Finsupp.sum, convexCombination]
    67    -- Expand convexCombination d using base point b
    68    conv_lhs =>
    69      congr; · skip
    70      ext d
